text:
Anika (Support): Hey team — Liam from AcmeCorp is seeing SSO failures after they rotated their IdP certs this morning. Their app gets 401 from our ACS handler and logs show 'SAML signature verification failed'. They say metadata looked fine to them. Can someone triage?

Liam (Customer): Yep, we rotated the signing cert at 08:12UTC. We updated metadata on our side and IdP says metadata fetch successful. Login flow was working before rotation, now users get 'invalid SAML response'.

sso-bot: Incoming metadata fetch for idp.acme.example on 2024-04-15T08:15:22Z — status: fetched, size: 12.4 KB, certs: 1 detected. SHA1 thumbprint: 3F:9A:..:B2

Maya (Identity Eng): Thanks Anika/Liam. Quick hypothesis: lots of IdPs publish only the leaf cert in <KeyDescriptor> and rely on TLS to present intermediate chain; we expect metadata to include all signing certs required for signature verification. Can you paste the metadata blob or a link?

Liam (Customer): Here's the metadata link: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml — when I curl it I get one <ds:X509Certificate> block. We did add the new cert only (we rotated the CA-subissued cert).

Anika (Support): Repro steps I ran:
1) curl -s -L "https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml" > meta.xml
2) grep -E "X509Certificate" -n meta.xml (shows single block)
3) Attempted login via our staging SP, saw 400 at /saml/acs and this server log: 
```
2024-04-15T08:22:11Z ERROR saml.handler: signature verification failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
Trace: verifySignature -> parseCert -> verifyChain
```

Maya (Identity Eng): That log is consistent with the SP not having the full chain needed to verify the signature. When the IdP signs with a leaf cert issued by an intermediate CA, the signature verification requires either the intermediate present in metadata or the IdP to include the full chain in the Signature's KeyInfo. Some IdPs don't include intermediates in metadata.

Jordi (Infra): Quick check — we cache IdP metadata for 10m. Anika did you try forcing a metadata refresh from the Console?

Anika (Support): Yes, I forced refresh at 08:30 (metadata fetch returned same single cert). Still failing.

Maya (Identity Eng): Two immediate mitigations:
- Short-term: Ask IdP to publish metadata containing the full cert chain (all X509Certificate entries in the KeyDescriptor for signing). That fixes us immediately.
- Workaround: If they can temporarily revert to the previous signing cert (if still valid) while they update metadata.

Liam (Customer): Is there anything you can do on your side? We can't quickly re-issue with the old cert. The IdP team says adding intermediate to metadata is nonstandard for them.

Maya (Identity Eng): We can try to accept the chain presented in the SAML Response if the <ds:Signature> includes KeyInfo with certificate chain — but that's disabled by default for stricter security. Nora, do we have a safe toggle to relax chain verification per-tenant while we wait?

Nora (Oncall): We have a per-tenant flag called allow_idp_chain_fallback but it's limited: it will accept a chain from the SAML response only if metadata explicitly allows dynamic KeyInfo (we require a metadata flag to avoid MITM). Enabling it requires a short config change and an audit entry. Note: it's riskier.

Anika (Support): Liam, would you be comfortable if we enable allow_idp_chain_fallback for AcmeCorp temporarily while you coordinate IdP metadata updates? We'll log the change and roll back once fixed.

Liam (Customer): Yes, please enable it. We'll get IdP to update metadata to include the intermediate cert within 24 hours.

Maya (Identity Eng): I'll open a ticket to enable the flag for tenant acme_corp (AU-3821). Will also add a monitoring alert for new SAML validation errors.

Jordi (Infra): Deployment note — changing that flag flips a runtime policy in the SP config. Expect ~30s for cache invalidation. I'll watch infra logs.

sso-bot: Tenant config change requested: allow_idp_chain_fallback = true for acme_corp by Maya — queued for rollout.

Jordi (Infra): Rolled out at 08:45:12Z. Cache invalidated.

Anika (Support): After rollout I tested login flow and got a successful redirect to our dashboard for one test user. Liam can you confirm your users are seeing success now?

Liam (Customer): Confirmed — a few users re-login successfully. Thanks! We're going to update metadata to include intermediate CA cert and will notify when done.

Maya (Identity Eng): Follow-up action items:
- Acme to publish metadata with full signing cert chain (X509Certificate entries for leaf + intermediate).
- We to revert allow_idp_chain_fallback to false after metadata is validated.
- Add diagnostic in our error page to surface 'missing intermediate in metadata' to make future triage faster.

Anika (Support): I'll keep thread open until Acme posts updated metadata. Marking as escalated -> identity eng.

Liam (Customer): Thanks everyone. Will post here once IdP metadata updated (ETA 4-6 hrs).

Maya (Identity Eng): Also attaching a quick curl command Acme can use to check the metadata contains multiple certs: 
```
curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath "count(//*[local-name()='X509Certificate'])" -
```

Anika (Support): Closing interim — Nora please set reminder to rollback flag in 24h if we don't hear back.

Nora (Oncall): Reminder scheduled: rollback allow_idp_chain_fallback for acme_corp at 2024-04-16T08:45:00Z unless ticket AU-3821 closed. :alarm_clock:"
